async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the homepage by clicking the link
    homepage_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark", exact=True)
    await homepage_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    
    # Step 2: Find the target post on the homepage
    # The target post title is 'Settle Down, Nerds. AI Is A Normal Technology'
    # Look for a link or article with this name
    target_post_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settle Down, Nerds. AI Is A Normal Technology", exact=False)
    if await target_post_link.count() == 0:
        # If not found as a link, try as an article or other element
        target_post_element = page.get_by_role("article", name="Settle Down, Nerds. AI Is A Normal Technology", exact=False)
        if await target_post_element.count() == 0:
            return "Target post not found on the homepage."
        else:
            # If it's an article, there might be a link inside it
            target_post_link = target_post_element.get_by_role("link")
    
    # Get the URL of the target post
    target_page_url = await target_post_link.get_attribute("href")
    if not target_page_url:
        return "Could not retrieve URL for the target post."
    
    # Step 3: Navigate to the target post
    await page.goto(target_page_url)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    
    # Step 4: Submit the comment using the knowledge base function
    comment_text = "Appreciate the detailed explanation."
    commenter_name = "Commenter"  # Placeholder name
    commenter_email = "commenter@example.com"  # Placeholder email
    commenter_website = ""  # Optional, leave empty
    save_details = True  # Default value
    
    result_message = await submit_comment_on_page(
        page,
        target_page_url,
        comment_text,
        commenter_name,
        commenter_email,
        commenter_website,
        save_details
    )
    
    return result_message
